quest.title: State of the Holy Lyre der Himmel
quest.description: After a fierce battle, you managed to seize the Holy Lyre der Himmel back from the hands of the Fatui. For some reason, Venti seems to express a great nostalgia for the Lyre...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Mora x5450, Character EXP x2850, Fine Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Bring the Holy Lyre back to the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Welcome back!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, this is the Holy Lyre! You managed to retrieve it!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The pattern of flowing wind carved on the rosewood... and the strings still feel cool to the touch too. Oh, the memories...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: What do you think, Venti? Can you summon Dvalin?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Although this lyre is the real thing, I doubt that it's going to work.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: As you can see, the lyre has been through a thousand years of history. Its Anemo power has run dry.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: In this condition, you couldn't play music fit for even Diluc's tavern with it...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Bards fight to get on the stage of my tavern. Don't make assumptions!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that really important right now, Master Diluc!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And you — did you just borrow the Holy Lyre to play music for drunkards to hear?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean "hehe"!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Anyway, we won't be able to call Dvalin with it.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The lyre itself is fine, but the strings...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You're up, outlander!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: It's just that the intensity of its Anemo power has greatly diminished.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you still have Dvalin's Teardrop Crystal with you?

choices.text: I don't know how to fix instruments.

talks.objective: Use Dvalin's Teardrop Crystal on the Holy Lyre

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: There's no time to lose. Use it on the Holy Lyre now!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It worked, as expected.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: This youthful glow...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Praising yourself? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...I was talking about the Holy Lyre.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #Thanks to {NICKNAME} having purified the crystal, the Holy Lyre won't continue to lose power.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That said, its power is far from replenished. It'd be great if we could get more tears.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I can surmise that Dvalin will already be crying...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Suffering alone in some deserted place...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: This is not something that an Honorary Knight can accomplish alone. I will mobilize the rest of the knights to assist.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: #When you get the Teardrop Crystal, please let {NICKNAME} perform the purification process.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Heroes supporting each other and setting out on a journey together... How exciting!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Lemme come up with a song for you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that all you're going to do? Just sing?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Wouldn't be much of a bard if I didn't now, would I?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph. You're so cheeky... You deserve an ugly nickname.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon knows! From now on, you'll be known as "<color=#00E1FFFF>Tone-Deaf Bard</color>"!

choices.text: Right. How do we do that?
How can we make Dvalin cry? By hitting him?
